answer: One concrete Sybil defense is non-transferable graded history: each identity must forge a copper-hard record of unique high-grade answers before its attestations carry weight. Recycled or template text is treated as a hollow fable that fails peer review and triggers slash. At the nadir of a farm the attacker faces steeply rising cost because every additional fake account requires its own independent trail of original reasoning that cannot be bulk-produced or shared without detection.
